```{r}
##Faecalis

e.faecalis <- data.frame(
  Treatment = c(

    rep("3.00%", 5), rep("1.50%", 5), rep("Pathogen + TSB", 5), rep("TSB", 5)
  ),
  Sample_ID = c(
    "1-1","1-2","1-3","1-4","1-5",
    "2-1","2-2","2-3","2-4","2-5",
    "3-1","3-2","3-3","3-4","3-5",
    "4-1","4-2","4-3","4-4","4-5",
    "5-1","5-2","5-3","5-4","5-5",
    "6-1","6-2","6-3","6-4","6-5",
    "7-1","7-2","7-3","7-4","7-5"
  ),
  Log10_6hr = c(
    4.477, 4.301, 4.845, 4.477, 4.602,
    6.000, 5.699, 6.079, 6.041, 5.954,
    7.255, 7.301, 7.176, 7.146, 7.000,
    7.903, 7.778, 7.477, 7.602, 7.301,
    7.845, 7.954, 7.477, 8.146, 8.114,
    8.477, 8.000, 8.301, 8.301, 9.380,
    0, 0, 0, 0, 0
  ),
  Log10_12hr = c(
    4.602, 4.602, 4.301, 4.301, 4.699,
    7.000, 7.000, 8.000, 7.000, 7.000,
    8.301, 8.000, 8.000, 8.322, 8.301,
    8.000, 8.301, 8.301, 8.301, 8.477,
    8.301, 8.477, 8.301, 8.301, 8.602,
    8.602, 8.602, 8.301, 8.602, 8.778,
    0, 0, 0, 0, 0
  ),
  Log10_24hr = c(
    4.000, 4.000, 4.301, 4.301, 4.301,
    7.301, 7.602, 7.699, 7.845, 4.000,
    8.146, 8.000, 7.903, 8.301, 8.000,
    8.322, 8.000, 8.000, 8.255, 8.000,
    8.845, 8.301, 8.699, 8.602, 8.602,
    8.845, 8.845, 8.778, 8.477, 8.778,
    0, 0, 0, 0, 0
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Factor treatment with meaningful order
e.faecalis$Treatment <- factor(e.faecalis$Treatment,
  levels = c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.50%", "3.00%", "6.00%", "12.00%", "24.00%")
)

cat("Dimensions:", dim(e.faecalis), "\n")
print(head(e.faecalis))

```

```{r}
##Visualize faecalis
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Pivot to long format
# ==============================================================

e.faecalis_long <- e.faecalis %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(
      gsub("Log10_", "", Timepoint),
      levels = c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Summary statistics
# ==============================================================

e.faecalis_summary <- e.faecalis_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Treatment, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. Define color palette: neutral for controls, gradient for doses
# ==============================================================

treatment_fills <- c(
  "TSB"            = "grey70",
  "Pathogen + TSB" = "grey40",
  "1.50%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.25),
  "3.00%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.40),
  "6.00%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.55),
  "12.00%"         = alpha("#bf3729", 0.75),
  "24.00%"         = alpha("#bf3729", 1.00)
)

# ==============================================================
# 4. Plot
# ==============================================================

dodge_width <- 0.8

p_faecalis <- ggplot(e.faecalis_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Mean, fill = Treatment)) +

  # Barplot
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    width = 0.75
  ) +

  # Error bars (mean ± SEM)
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # Individual points
  geom_point(
    data = e.faecalis_long,
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = Log10, fill = Treatment, group = Treatment),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = dodge_width),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.7,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_fills) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +

  labs(
    x = "Time Post-Treatment",
    y = expression(bold(Log[10]~CFU/mL)),
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_faecalis)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Pivot to long format
# ==============================================================

e.faecalis_long <- e.faecalis %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(
      gsub("Log10_", "", Timepoint),
      levels = c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr")
    ),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment,
      levels = c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.50%", "3.00%", "6.00%", "12.00%", "24.00%")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Summary statistics
# ==============================================================

e.faecalis_summary <- e.faecalis_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Treatment, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. CLD annotations (Tukey groups from statistical output)
# ==============================================================

cld_df <- data.frame(
  Treatment = rep(c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.50%", "3.00%", "6.00%", "12.00%", "24.00%"), 3),
  Timepoint = rep(c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr"), each = 7),
  CLD = c(
    # 6hr Tukey groups
    "", "a", "b", "bc", "c", "d", "e",
    # 12hr Tukey groups
    "", "a", "a", "a", "a", "b", "c",
    # 24hr Tukey groups
    "", "a", "a", "ab", "ab", "b", "c"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment,
      levels = c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.50%", "3.00%", "6.00%", "12.00%", "24.00%")
    ),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr"))
  )

# Merge CLD with summary to get y-positions
cld_df <- cld_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(e.faecalis_summary, by = c("Treatment", "Timepoint")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + SEM + 0.3
  )

# ==============================================================
# 4. Define color palette
# ==============================================================

treatment_fills <- c(
  "TSB"            = "grey70",
  "Pathogen + TSB" = "grey40",
  "1.50%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.25),
  "3.00%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.40),
  "6.00%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.55),
  "12.00%"         = alpha("#bf3729", 0.75),
  "24.00%"         = alpha("#bf3729", 1.00)
)

# ==============================================================
# 5. Plot
# ==============================================================

dodge_width <- 0.8

p_faecalis <- ggplot(e.faecalis_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Mean, fill = Treatment)) +

  # Barplot
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    width = 0.75
  ) +

  # Error bars (mean ± SEM)
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # Individual points
  geom_point(
    data = e.faecalis_long,
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = Log10, fill = Treatment, group = Treatment),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = dodge_width),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.7,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # CLD letters
  geom_text(
    data = cld_df,
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = y_pos, label = CLD, group = Treatment),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    size = 2.75,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_fills) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +

  labs(
    x = "Time Post-Inoculation",
    y = expression(bold(Log[10]~CFU/mL)),
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_faecalis)

# ==============================================================
# 6. Save
# ==============================================================

png("e_faecalis_invitro.png", width = 6, height = 3.5, units = "in", res = 900)
print(p_faecalis)
dev.off()

cat("\nE. faecalis in vitro plot saved.\n")

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggtext)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Combine all three strains into one long data frame
# ==============================================================

e.faecalis_long <- e.faecalis %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Strain = "*E. faecalis*")

e.cecorum7_long <- e.cecorum7 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Strain = "*E. cecorum* strain 7")

e.cecorum5_long <- e.cecorum5 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Strain = "*E. cecorum* strain 5")

all_strains_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(e.faecalis_long, e.cecorum7_long, e.cecorum5_long) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(
      gsub("Log10_", "", Timepoint),
      levels = c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr")
    ),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment,
      levels = c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.50%", "3.00%", "6.00%", "12.00%", "24.00%")
    ),
    Strain = factor(Strain,
      levels = c("*E. faecalis*", "*E. cecorum* strain 7", "*E. cecorum* strain 5")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Summary statistics
# ==============================================================

all_strains_summary <- all_strains_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, Treatment, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. CLD annotations for all three strains
# ==============================================================

cld_df <- data.frame(
  Strain = rep(
    c("*E. faecalis*", "*E. cecorum* strain 7", "*E. cecorum* strain 5"),
    each = 21
  ),
  Treatment = rep(
    rep(c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.50%", "3.00%", "6.00%", "12.00%", "24.00%"), 3),
    3
  ),
  Timepoint = rep(
    rep(c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr"), each = 7),
    3
  ),
  CLD = c(
    # E. faecalis
    "", "a", "b", "bc", "c", "d", "e",       # 6hr
    "", "a", "a", "a", "a", "b", "c",         # 12hr
    "", "a", "a", "ab", "ab", "b", "c",       # 24hr
    # E. cecorum strain 7
    "", "ab", "a", "b", "c", "d", "e",        # 6hr
    "", "a", "a", "a", "b", "c", "d",         # 12hr
    "", "a", "ab", "bc", "c", "d", "e",       # 24hr
    # E. cecorum strain 5
    "", "a", "a", "b", "b", "c", "d",         # 6hr
    "", "a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f",         # 12hr
    "", "a", "ab", "ab", "ab", "b", "c"       # 24hr
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Strain = factor(Strain,
      levels = c("*E. faecalis*", "*E. cecorum* strain 7", "*E. cecorum* strain 5")
    ),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment,
      levels = c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.50%", "3.00%", "6.00%", "12.00%", "24.00%")
    ),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr"))
  )

cld_df <- cld_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_strains_summary, by = c("Strain", "Treatment", "Timepoint")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + SEM + 0.5
  )

# ==============================================================
# 4. Define color palette
# ==============================================================

treatment_fills <- c(
  "TSB"            = "grey70",
  "Pathogen + TSB" = "grey40",
  "1.50%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.25),
  "3.00%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.40),
  "6.00%"          = alpha("#bf3729", 0.55),
  "12.00%"         = alpha("#bf3729", 0.75),
  "24.00%"         = alpha("#bf3729", 1.00)
)

# ==============================================================
# 5. Plot
# ==============================================================

dodge_width <- 0.8

p_all_strains <- ggplot(all_strains_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Mean, fill = Treatment)) +

  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    width = 0.75
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = all_strains_long,
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = Log10, fill = Treatment, group = Treatment),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = dodge_width),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.7,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = cld_df,
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = y_pos, label = CLD, group = Treatment),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    size = 2.75,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Strain, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_fills) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +

  labs(
    x = "Time Post-Inoculation",
    y = expression(bold(Log[10]~CFU/mL)),
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_markdown(size = 11, color = "white", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "black")
  )

print(p_all_strains)

# ==============================================================
# 6. Save
# ==============================================================

png("enterococcus_invitro_faceted.png", width = 7, height = 5.5, units = "in", res = 900)
print(p_all_strains)
dev.off()

cat("\nFaceted Enterococcus in vitro plot saved.\n")
```

```{r}
## ==============================================================
## Hirae in vitro data: log10 CFU/mL, ANOVA, t-tests, Tukey HSD, plot
## ==============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(multcompView)
library(scales)

alpha <- 0.05

# ==============================================================
# 1. Prepare data
# ==============================================================

hirae_plot_df <- hirae %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment_raw = as.character(`ILT.conc.....`),

    # Updated logic
    Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      Replicate == "TSB only" ~ "TSB",
      Treatment_raw == "0"    ~ "Pathogen + TSB",
      TRUE ~ paste0(Treatment_raw, "%")
    ),

    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),

    Timepoint = factor(
      paste0(`Time.Point..h.`, "hr"),
      levels = c("0hr", "6hr", "12hr", "24hr")
    ),

    Log10 = dplyr::if_else(CFU.ml > 0, log10(CFU.ml), 0)
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Summary statistics
# ==============================================================

hirae_summary <- hirae_plot_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Treatment, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. One-way ANOVA at each timepoint
# ==============================================================

hirae_anova_results <- hirae_plot_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    out <- summary(fit)[[1]]
    data.frame(
      df_treatment = out["Treatment", "Df"],
      df_residual  = out["Residuals", "Df"],
      F_value      = out["Treatment", "F value"],
      p_value      = out["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

print(hirae_anova_results)

# ==============================================================
# 4. Pairwise Student's t-tests at each timepoint
# ==============================================================

hirae_pairwise_ttests <- lapply(levels(hirae_plot_df$Timepoint), function(tp) {
  df_tp <- hirae_plot_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Timepoint == tp)

  pairwise.t.test(
    x = df_tp$Log10,
    g = df_tp$Treatment,
    p.adjust.method = "none",
    pool.sd = FALSE
  )
})

names(hirae_pairwise_ttests) <- levels(hirae_plot_df$Timepoint)

hirae_pairwise_ttests

# ==============================================================
# 5. Tukey HSD at each timepoint
# ==============================================================

hirae_tukey_results <- lapply(levels(hirae_plot_df$Timepoint), function(tp) {
  df_tp <- hirae_plot_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Timepoint == tp)

  fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = df_tp)
  TukeyHSD(fit)
})

names(hirae_tukey_results) <- levels(hirae_plot_df$Timepoint)

hirae_tukey_results

# ==============================================================
# 6. Tukey CLD letters
# ==============================================================

cld_list <- lapply(levels(hirae_plot_df$Timepoint), function(tp) {
  df_tp <- hirae_plot_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Timepoint == tp)

  fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = df_tp)
  tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)

  cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(fit, tuk)

  data.frame(
    Timepoint = tp,
    Treatment = names(cld$Treatment$Letters),
    CLD = cld$Treatment$Letters,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

cld_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(cld_list) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("0hr", "6hr", "12hr", "24hr")),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("TSB", "Pathogen + TSB", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hirae_summary, by = c("Treatment", "Timepoint")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + SEM + 0.4
  )

# ==============================================================
# 7. Define color palette
# ==============================================================

treatment_fills <- c(
  "TSB"              = "grey70",
  "Pathogen + TSB"   = "grey40",
  "1.5%"             = scales::alpha("#bf3729", 0.25),
  "3%"               = scales::alpha("#bf3729", 0.40),
  "6%"               = scales::alpha("#bf3729", 0.55),
  "12%"              = scales::alpha("#bf3729", 0.75),
  "24%"              = scales::alpha("#bf3729", 1.00)
)

# ==============================================================
# 8. Plot
# ==============================================================

dodge_width <- 0.8

p_hirae <- ggplot(hirae_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Mean, fill = Treatment)) +

  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    width = 0.75
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = hirae_plot_df,
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = Log10, fill = Treatment, group = Treatment),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = dodge_width),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.7,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = cld_df,
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = y_pos, label = CLD, group = Treatment),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    size = 2.75,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_fills) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) +

  labs(
    x = "Time Post-Inoculation",
    y = expression(bold(Log[10]~CFU/mL)),
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_hirae)

# ==============================================================
# 9. Save
# ==============================================================

png("hirae_invitro.png", width = 6, height = 3.5, units = "in", res = 900)
print(p_hirae)
dev.off()

cat("\nHirae in vitro plot saved.\n")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggtext)
library(multcompView)
library(scales)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Prepare E. cecorum strain 7
# ==============================================================

e.cecorum7_long <- e.cecorum7 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pathogen = "*E. cecorum* strain 7",
    Timepoint = gsub("Log10_", "", Timepoint)
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Prepare E. cecorum strain 5
# ==============================================================

e.cecorum5_long <- e.cecorum5 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pathogen = "*E. cecorum* strain 5",
    Timepoint = gsub("Log10_", "", Timepoint)
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. Prepare E. hirae
# ==============================================================

hirae_long <- hirae %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment_raw = as.character(`ILT.conc.....`),
    Treatment_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Treatment_raw)),
    Replicate_chr = as.character(Replicate),

    Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      Replicate_chr == "TSB only" ~ "TSB",
      Treatment_num == 0          ~ "CT",
      Treatment_num == 1.5        ~ "1.5%",
      Treatment_num == 3          ~ "3%",
      Treatment_num == 6          ~ "6%",
      Treatment_num == 12         ~ "12%",
      Treatment_num == 24         ~ "24%",
      TRUE ~ paste0(Treatment_raw, "%")
    ),

    Timepoint = paste0(`Time.Point..h.`, "hr"),
    Log10 = dplyr::if_else(CFU.ml > 0, log10(CFU.ml), 0),
    Pathogen = "*E. hirae*"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Pathogen, Treatment, Timepoint, Log10)

# ==============================================================
# 4. Combine + clean
# ==============================================================

all_pathogens_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  e.cecorum7_long,
  e.cecorum5_long,
  hirae_long
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(Treatment),
      "Pathogen + TSB" = "CT",
      "1.50%" = "1.5%",
      "3.00%" = "3%",
      "6.00%" = "6%",
      "12.00%" = "12%",
      "24.00%" = "24%"
    ),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr")),
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("TSB", "CT", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),
    Pathogen = factor(
      Pathogen,
      levels = c("*E. cecorum* strain 7", "*E. cecorum* strain 5", "*E. hirae*")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 5. Summary stats
# ==============================================================

all_pathogens_summary <- all_pathogens_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Pathogen, Timepoint, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 6. One-way ANOVA by pathogen and timepoint
# ==============================================================

anova_results <- all_pathogens_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Pathogen, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    out <- summary(fit)[[1]]

    data.frame(
      df_treatment = out["Treatment", "Df"],
      df_residual  = out["Residuals", "Df"],
      F_value      = out["Treatment", "F value"],
      p_value      = out["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

print(anova_results)

# ==============================================================
# 7. Pairwise Student's t-tests by pathogen and timepoint
# ==============================================================

pairwise_ttest_results <- all_pathogens_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Pathogen, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::group_split() %>%
  setNames(
    all_pathogens_long %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Pathogen, Timepoint) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(name = paste(Pathogen, Timepoint, sep = " | ")) %>%
      dplyr::pull(name)
  ) %>%
  lapply(function(df) {
    pairwise.t.test(
      x = df$Log10,
      g = df$Treatment,
      p.adjust.method = "none",
      pool.sd = FALSE
    )
  })

pairwise_ttest_results

# ==============================================================
# 8. Tukey HSD + CLD letters by pathogen and timepoint
# ==============================================================

cld_df <- all_pathogens_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Pathogen, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)
    cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(fit, tuk)

    data.frame(
      Treatment = names(cld$Treatment$Letters),
      CLD = cld$Treatment$Letters,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("TSB", "CT", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    all_pathogens_summary,
    by = c("Pathogen", "Timepoint", "Treatment")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + SEM + 0.5
  )

# ==============================================================
# 9. Viridis-style palette
# ==============================================================

treatment_fills <- c(
  "TSB"  = "grey85",
  "CT"   = "grey45",
  "1.5%" = "#fcfdbf",
  "3%"   = "#febb81",
  "6%"   = "#f8765c",
  "12%"  = "#982d80",
  "24%"  = "#221150"
)

# ==============================================================
# 10. Plot: 3 pathogens x 3 timepoints
# ==============================================================

p_pathogen_time <- ggplot(
  all_pathogens_summary,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Mean, fill = Treatment)
) +

  geom_col(
    color = "black",
    #linewidth = 0.3,
    width = 0.75
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    width = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = all_pathogens_long,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Log10),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.4,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = cld_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos, label = CLD),
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -0.35,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Pathogen),
    cols = vars(Timepoint),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_fills, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(bold(Log[10]~CFU/mL))
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "white", face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 7, color = "white", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "black")
  )

print(p_pathogen_time)

# ==============================================================
# 11. Save
# ==============================================================

png(
  "cecorum_hirae_invitro_3x3_faceted.png",
  width = 8,
  height = 3.75,
  units = "in",
  res = 900
)
print(p_pathogen_time)
dev.off()

cat("\nUpdated 3x3 faceted E. cecorum + E. hirae in vitro plot saved.\n")
```

```{r}
## ==============================================================
## Biofilm MBIC data: raw OD 540 nm visualization + ANOVA/Tukey
## Boxplots with raw points + mean stat summaries
## Updated to match 3x3 in vitro plot aesthetics
## ==============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(multcompView)
library(scales)
library(ggtext)

alpha <- 0.05

# ==============================================================
# 1. Prepare E. hirae biofilm data
# ==============================================================

hirae_biofilm_long <- hirae.mbic %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Replicate = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -Replicate,
    names_to = "Treatment_raw",
    values_to = "Biomass"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      Treatment_raw == "E.h."    ~ "CT",
      Treatment_raw == "Vanc"    ~ "Van",
      Treatment_raw == "X0.75."  ~ "0.75%",
      Treatment_raw == "X1.50."  ~ "1.5%",
      Treatment_raw == "X3."     ~ "3%",
      Treatment_raw == "X6."     ~ "6%",
      Treatment_raw == "X12."    ~ "12%",
      Treatment_raw == "X24."    ~ "24%",
      TRUE ~ Treatment_raw
    ),
    Strain = "*E. hirae*"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Prepare E. cecorum biofilm data
# ==============================================================

cecorum_biofilm_long <- cecorum.mbic %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Replicate = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -Replicate,
    names_to = "Treatment_raw",
    values_to = "Biomass"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      Treatment_raw == "E.h."    ~ "CT",
      Treatment_raw == "Vanc"    ~ "Van",
      Treatment_raw == "X0.75."  ~ "0.75%",
      Treatment_raw == "X1.50."  ~ "1.5%",
      Treatment_raw == "X3."     ~ "3%",
      Treatment_raw == "X6."     ~ "6%",
      Treatment_raw == "X12."    ~ "12%",
      Treatment_raw == "X24."    ~ "24%",
      TRUE ~ Treatment_raw
    ),
    Strain = "*E. cecorum*"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. Combine data
# ==============================================================

biofilm_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  hirae_biofilm_long,
  cecorum_biofilm_long
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("CT", "Van", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),
    Strain = factor(
      Strain,
      levels = c("*E. hirae*", "*E. cecorum*")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 4. Summary statistics
# ==============================================================

biofilm_summary <- biofilm_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    CI95 = qt(0.975, df = N - 1) * SEM,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 5. ANOVA by strain
# ==============================================================

biofilm_anova_results <- biofilm_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Biomass ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    out <- summary(fit)[[1]]

    data.frame(
      df_treatment = out["Treatment", "Df"],
      df_residual  = out["Residuals", "Df"],
      F_value      = out["Treatment", "F value"],
      p_value      = out["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

print(biofilm_anova_results)

# ==============================================================
# 6. Tukey HSD + CLD
# ==============================================================

biofilm_cld_df <- biofilm_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Biomass ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)
    cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(fit, tuk)

    data.frame(
      Treatment = names(cld$Treatment$Letters),
      CLD = cld$Treatment$Letters,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("CT", "Van", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(biofilm_summary, by = c("Strain", "Treatment")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + CI95 + 0.03
  )

# ==============================================================
# 7. Viridis-style palette
# ==============================================================

biofilm_fills <- c(
  "CT"    = "grey45",
  "Van"   = "grey85",
  "0.75%" = "#fcfdbf",
  "1.5%"  = "#febb81",
  "3%"    = "#f8765c",
  "6%"    = "#d3436e",
  "12%"   = "#982d80",
  "24%"   = "#221150"
)

biofilm_point_colors <- setNames(
  rep("black", length(biofilm_fills)),
  names(biofilm_fills)
)

# ==============================================================
# 8. Plot
# ==============================================================

p_biofilm <- ggplot(biofilm_long, aes(x = Treatment, y = Biomass)) +

  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    color = "white",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill = "white",
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = biofilm_cld_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos, label = CLD),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Strain, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = biofilm_fills, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = biofilm_point_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Biomass (OD 540 nm)",
    fill = "Treatment",
    color = "Treatment"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 7, color = "white", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "black")
  )

print(p_biofilm)

# ==============================================================
# 9. Save
# ==============================================================

png("biofilm_mbic_boxplot.png", width = 5, height = 3.75, units = "in", res = 900)
print(p_biofilm)
dev.off()

cat("\nBiofilm MBIC boxplot saved.\n")

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 8. Plot biofilm inhibition with existing CLDs

# Convert OD/normalized biomass values to % biomass and % inhibition
# relative to the untreated control mean within each strain.
biofilm_long_plot <- biofilm_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CT_mean = mean(Biomass[Treatment == "CT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Biomass_percent = (Biomass / CT_mean) * 100,
    Inhibition = 100 - Biomass_percent
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Recalculate plotting positions for the existing CLDs on the inhibition scale.
# CLDs still come from ANOVA + Tukey HSD on Biomass.
biofilm_cld_plot_df <- biofilm_cld_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CT_mean = Mean[Treatment == "CT"],
    Mean_Biomass_percent = (Mean / CT_mean) * 100,
    Mean_Inhibition = 100 - Mean_Biomass_percent,
    CI95_Inhibition = (CI95 / CT_mean) * 100,
    y_pos = Mean_Inhibition + CI95_Inhibition + 3
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

p_biofilm_inhibition <- ggplot(
  biofilm_long_plot,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Inhibition)
) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 50,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    color = "white",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill = "white",
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = biofilm_cld_plot_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos, label = CLD),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Strain, ncol = 1) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = biofilm_fills, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = biofilm_point_colors, drop = FALSE) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "% biofilm inhibition",
    fill = "Treatment",
    color = "Treatment"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 10,
      color = "white",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "black")
  )

print(p_biofilm_inhibition)

png("p_biofilm_inhibition.png", width = 5, height = 3.75, units = "in", res = 900)
print(p_biofilm_inhibition)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
##Update plot
# Convert OD/normalized biomass values to % biomass and % inhibition
# Update palette names if they still use CT.
if ("CT" %in% names(biofilm_fills)) {
  names(biofilm_fills)[names(biofilm_fills) == "CT"] <- "BCT"
}

if ("CT" %in% names(biofilm_point_colors)) {
  names(biofilm_point_colors)[names(biofilm_point_colors) == "CT"] <- "BCT"
}

# Preserve treatment order while relabeling CT as BCT.
biofilm_treatment_levels <- biofilm_long %>%
  dplyr::pull(Treatment) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique()

biofilm_treatment_levels <- dplyr::recode(
  biofilm_treatment_levels,
  "CT" = "BCT"
)

biofilm_long_plot <- biofilm_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::recode(as.character(Treatment), "CT" = "BCT"),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = biofilm_treatment_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    BCT_mean = mean(Biomass[Treatment == "BCT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Biomass_percent = (Biomass / BCT_mean) * 100,
    Inhibition = 100 - Biomass_percent
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Format ANOVA p-values.
fmt_p_rich <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("<i>p</i> = NA")
  if (p < 0.01) {
    paste0("<i>p</i> = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1))
  } else {
    paste0("<i>p</i> = ", sprintf("%.2f", p))
  }
}

biofilm_anova_label_df <- biofilm_anova_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    P_Label = paste0("ANOVA ", vapply(p_value, fmt_p_rich, character(1))),
    x_lab = 0.65,
    y_lab = Inf
  )

# Recalculate plotting positions for the existing CLDs on the inhibition scale.
# CLDs still come from ANOVA + Tukey HSD on Biomass.
biofilm_cld_plot_df <- biofilm_cld_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::recode(as.character(Treatment), "CT" = "BCT"),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = biofilm_treatment_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    BCT_mean = Mean[Treatment == "BCT"],
    Mean_Biomass_percent = (Mean / BCT_mean) * 100,
    Mean_Inhibition = 100 - Mean_Biomass_percent,
    CI95_Inhibition = (CI95 / BCT_mean) * 100,
    y_pos = Mean_Inhibition + CI95_Inhibition + 3
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

p_biofilm_inhibition <- ggplot(
  biofilm_long_plot,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Inhibition)
) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 50,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    color = "white",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill = "white",
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = biofilm_cld_plot_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos, label = CLD),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -2.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = biofilm_anova_label_df,
    aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = P_Label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2,
    size = 3.5,
    fill = NA,
    label.colour = NA,
    label.padding = unit(0, "lines"),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ forcats::fct_rev(Strain), ncol = 1) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = biofilm_fills, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = biofilm_point_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.30))

  labs(
    x = NULL,

    fill = "Treatment",
    color = "Treatment"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
```

```{r}
##Updated clinical isolate plot to show % inhibition

# ==============================================================
# Clinical isolate growth inhibition plot
# Strains: EC5, EC7, E. hirae
# Run ANOVA + Tukey HSD for all strains, generate CLDs + ANOVA p
# Plot % growth inhibition relative to BCT
# ==============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggtext)
library(multcompView)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Combine all three strains into one long data frame
# ==============================================================

e.cecorum7_long <- e.cecorum7 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Strain = "EC7",
    Timepoint = gsub("Log10_", "", Timepoint)
  )

e.cecorum5_long <- e.cecorum5 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Log10_"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Strain = "EC5",
    Timepoint = gsub("Log10_", "", Timepoint)
  )

hirae_long <- hirae %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment_raw = as.character(`ILT.conc.....`),
    Treatment_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Treatment_raw)),
    Replicate_chr = as.character(Replicate),

    Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      Replicate_chr == "TSB only" ~ "TSB",
      Treatment_num == 0          ~ "BCT",
      Treatment_num == 1.5        ~ "1.5%",
      Treatment_num == 3          ~ "3%",
      Treatment_num == 6          ~ "6%",
      Treatment_num == 12         ~ "12%",
      Treatment_num == 24         ~ "24%",
      TRUE ~ paste0(Treatment_raw, "%")
    ),

    Timepoint = paste0(`Time.Point..h.`, "hr"),
    Log10 = dplyr::if_else(CFU.ml > 0, log10(CFU.ml), 0),
    Strain = "*E. hirae*"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Strain, Treatment, Timepoint, Log10)

all_strains_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  e.cecorum7_long,
  e.cecorum5_long,
  hirae_long
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(Treatment),
      "Pathogen + TSB" = "BCT",
      "1.50%" = "1.5%",
      "3.00%" = "3%",
      "6.00%" = "6%",
      "12.00%" = "12%",
      "24.00%" = "24%"
    ),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("6hr", "12hr", "24hr")),
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("TSB", "BCT", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),
    Strain = factor(
      Strain,
      levels = c("EC5", "EC7", "*E. hirae*")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Summary statistics on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

all_strains_summary <- all_strains_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, Treatment, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. ANOVA p-values
# ==============================================================

fmt_p_rich <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("<i>p</i> = NA")
  if (p < 0.01) {
    paste0("<i>p</i> = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1))
  } else {
    paste0("<i>p</i> = ", sprintf("%.2f", p))
  }
}

anova_results_all_strains <- all_strains_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "TSB") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    out <- summary(fit)[[1]]

    data.frame(
      df_treatment = out["Treatment", "Df"],
      df_residual  = out["Residuals", "Df"],
      F_value      = out["Treatment", "F value"],
      p_value      = out["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

anova_label_df <- anova_results_all_strains %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    P_Label = paste0("ANOVA ", vapply(p_value, fmt_p_rich, character(1))),
    x_lab = 0.65,
    y_lab = Inf
  )

# ==============================================================
# 4. Tukey HSD + CLD
# ==============================================================

cld_df_all_strains <- all_strains_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "TSB") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)
    cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(fit, tuk)

    data.frame(
      Treatment = names(cld$Treatment$Letters),
      CLD = cld$Treatment$Letters,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("BCT", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),
    Strain = factor(
      Strain,
      levels = c("EC5", "EC7", "*E. hirae*")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 5. % growth inhibition relative to BCT
# ==============================================================

all_strains_inhibition_long <- all_strains_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "TSB") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    BCT_mean = mean(Log10[Treatment == "BCT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Growth_inhibition = ((BCT_mean - Log10) / BCT_mean) * 100,
    Growth_inhibition = pmax(0, pmin(100, Growth_inhibition)),
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("BCT", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),
    Strain = factor(
      Strain,
      levels = c("EC5", "EC7", "*E. hirae*")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

all_strains_inhibition_summary <- all_strains_inhibition_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Strain, Timepoint, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Growth_inhibition, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Growth_inhibition, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cld_inhibition_df <- cld_df_all_strains %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    all_strains_inhibition_summary,
    by = c("Strain", "Timepoint", "Treatment")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + SEM + 5
  )

# ==============================================================
# 6. Colors
# ==============================================================

treatment_fills_inhibition <- c(
  "BCT"  = "grey45",
  "1.5%" = "#fcfdbf",
  "3%"   = "#febb81",
  "6%"   = "#f8765c",
  "12%"  = "#982d80",
  "24%"  = "#221150"
)

  ) +
  geom_errorbar(

    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(

    aes(x = Treatment, y = Growth_inhibition),

    size = 1.4,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = cld_inhibition_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos, label = CLD),
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -0.75,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = anova_label_df,
    aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = P_Label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2,
    size = 2.5,
    fill = NA,
    label.colour = NA,
    label.padding = unit(0, "lines"),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Strain),

  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_fills_inhibition, drop = FALSE) +

    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 12),

  )

print(p_pathogen_time_inhibition)
```

```{r}
##ATCC biofilm OD with reverse orientation

# ==============================================================
# Biofilm MBIC boxplot — flipped, strains as columns
# Includes ANOVA p-values + corrected CLD positions
# ==============================================================
fmt_p_rich <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("<i>p</i> = NA")
  if (p < 0.01) {
    paste0("<i>p</i> = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1))
  } else {
    paste0("<i>p</i> = ", sprintf("%.2f", p))
  }
}
biofilm_long_flip <- biofilm_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = rev(c("CT", "Van", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%"))
    )
  )
biofilm_cld_df_flip <- biofilm_cld_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = levels(biofilm_long_flip$Treatment)
    ),
    y_pos_flip = y_pos + 0.06
  )
# After coord_flip:
#   x = Treatment becomes vertical axis  (level 1 = bottom, last level = top)
#   y = Biomass becomes horizontal axis  (-Inf = left, +Inf = right)
# Bottom-right visually = FIRST Treatment level + high Biomass value
biofilm_anova_label_df_flip <- biofilm_anova_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    P_Label = paste0("ANOVA ", vapply(p_value, fmt_p_rich, character(1))),
    x_lab = levels(biofilm_long_flip$Treatment)[1],   # bottom of axis
    y_lab = Inf                                        # right side
  )
p_biofilm_flip <- ggplot(
  biofilm_long_flip,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Biomass)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    color = "white",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill = "white",
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = biofilm_cld_df_flip,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos_flip, label = CLD),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = -0.25,
    vjust = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = biofilm_anova_label_df_flip,
    aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = P_Label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.05,         # inset from right edge
    vjust = 3.25,         # push up off the bottom edge
    size = 2.55,
    fill = NA,
    label.colour = NA,
    label.padding = unit(0, "lines"),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Strain,
    ncol = 2,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = biofilm_fills, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = biofilm_point_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.35))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Biomass (OD 540 nm)",
    fill = "Treatment",
    color = "Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 8,
      color = "white",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    strip.clip = "off",                 # stops the strip border being trimmed
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "black",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.35                  # matched to panel.border so edges align
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 18, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

print(p_biofilm_flip)

png(
  "biofilm_mbic_boxplot_flip.png",
  width = 4.85,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "in",
  res = 900
)
print(p_biofilm_flip)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
##Pull clinical isolate info for results section

# ==============================================================
# 9. Extended summary: % inhibition, log10 reduction, fold change
# ==============================================================

ct_lookup <- all_pathogens_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment == "CT") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Pathogen, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    CT_mean_log10 = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pathogen_summary_extended <- all_pathogens_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "TSB") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ct_lookup,
    by = c("Pathogen", "Timepoint")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log10_reduction_vs_CT = CT_mean_log10 - Mean,
    fold_reduction_vs_CT  = 10^log10_reduction_vs_CT,
    pct_inhibition = ((CT_mean_log10 - Mean) / CT_mean_log10) * 100,
    pct_inhibition = pmax(0, pmin(100, pct_inhibition))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Pathogen, Timepoint, Treatment)

print(pathogen_summary_extended, n = Inf)


# ==============================================================
# 10. CT reference summary
# ==============================================================

ct_reference <- all_pathogens_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment == "CT") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Pathogen, Timepoint)

print(ct_reference, n = Inf)


# ==============================================================
# 11. Clean ANOVA output
# ==============================================================

anova_results_clean <- anova_results %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Pathogen, Timepoint)

print(anova_results_clean, n = Inf)


# ==============================================================
# 12. Tukey HSD pairwise p values
# ==============================================================

tukey_pairwise_pathogens <- all_pathogens_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "TSB") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Pathogen, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)$Treatment

    as.data.frame(tuk) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("contrast") %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        diff_log10 = diff,
        lower_ci   = lwr,
        upper_ci   = upr,
        p_adj      = `p adj`
      )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Pathogen, Timepoint, p_adj)

print(tukey_pairwise_pathogens, n = Inf)


# ==============================================================
# 13. Tukey comparisons versus CT only
# ==============================================================

tukey_vs_CT_pathogens <- tukey_pairwise_pathogens %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("CT", contrast)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Pathogen, Timepoint, p_adj)

print(tukey_vs_CT_pathogens, n = Inf)
```
